pairs.a: Tourists gathered at the far end of the crowded market square.
pairs.b: Tourists gathered at the near end of the crowded market square.

pairs.a: Talk in the room drifted toward the far future of the city.
pairs.b: Talk in the room drifted toward the near future of the city.

pairs.a: Through the open window came the far hum of traffic on the highway.
pairs.b: Through the open window came the near hum of traffic on the highway.

pairs.a: The visitor had moved to a far suburb last spring and still felt lost.
pairs.b: The visitor had moved to a near suburb last spring and still felt lost.

pairs.a: A group of students sat together at the far table by the window.
pairs.b: A group of students sat together at the near table by the window.
